title: EXAMPLE: Check the airport link before you leave the terminal

children.text: Example only. This is not a verified timetable, fare, or named operator.
Confirm today’s airport-to-city option from the operator, not from an old screenshot.
Check the last return that still gets you back for crew report.
Look up the platform and the fare yourself. This sample deliberately leaves them out.

title: EXAMPLE: Eat close to the hotel

children.text: Example only. No restaurant, café, or dish is recommended here. If the layover is only a few hours, eat within walking distance of where the crew is staying and keep whatever receipt habit your airline already uses. Verify opening hours yourself.

title: EXAMPLE: Guard a sleep block before report

children.text: Example only. This is a general rest habit, not medical advice. Put the report time in your phone, tell a colleague when you expect to be back, and drop the city plan if you are short on sleep.

title: EXAMPLE: Choose the airport ride before you exit

children.text: Example only. This sample does not name a taxi company, metro line, or fare. Decide how you will get to the hotel before you leave the arrivals hall, and leave more time for the return than the outbound ride took.

title: EXAMPLE: Plan for heat if you will be outside

children.text: Example only. This is not weather or health advice. If you leave the hotel, check the day’s temperature yourself, carry water, and skip a long unsheltered walk in the hottest part of the day. Nothing here was verified for a particular season.

title: EXAMPLE: Arrange the airport ride with your crew

children.text: Example only. This is not a recommendation of a road, a rank, or a car service. Agree the ride with your crew or the hotel before landing, share the plan with a colleague, and do not treat this sample as local transport guidance.

title: EXAMPLE: Eat where the crew already has a booking

children.text: Example only. No restaurant, market, or dish is named on purpose. Use a booking the crew or hotel already holds, and treat any other food idea as something you still have to verify.

title: EXAMPLE: Use the transport arranged for the crew

children.text: Example only. This sample does not name a road, a rank, or a fare. Use the pickup your airline or hotel arranged, and confirm the return time while you are still at the airport.

title: EXAMPLE: Keep the outing inside a short radius

children.text: Example only. No park, neighbourhood, or attraction is recommended here. If you have a few hours, stay close enough to the hotel that a delay still gets you back before report. Check what is actually open that day.

title: EXAMPLE: Write down the time you need to be back

children.text: Example only. A general rest habit, not local security advice. Note the report time, tell a colleague your plan, and skip the outing if the rest window is already short.
